body: CORRECTED AGAIN (Termal::Architect1, 2026-10-22 23:26Z; revision 4 removes an unsupported inference from revision 3). Facts from w-06fb930cac38 on 2026-10-22: three acceptance evaluations were refused at submit with "the task no longer names the evaluated source root under claim generation N" — 21:44Z (generation 1758, naming revision 1 at capture), 21:47Z after a >60 s idle gap (generation 1758, naming revision 1 at capture AGAIN, so the first attempt left no persisted bump behind), and 23:05Z after 37 idle minutes on a fresh main-checkout naming made under the current claim (generation 1762, naming revision 2 at capture). The idle-gap workaround of revision 2 therefore does NOT work, and a second request right after a refusal does NOT pass either. BarA1's code trace (w-33f4 note 4ba736bc…): request and submit do no canonical learn; every revision bump goes through learn_engram_authority_locked, reached on the evaluation path by the evaluator CHILD's turn admission (child.engram.work_binding → reconcile_engram_root_for_admission_until → guard → prepare → read → learn, engram_named_root_binding.rs:2157) after the parent's token capture, and by the parent's own mail-wake turns during the wait. Why attempt 2 captured revision 1 again is not explained by that trace; BarA1 owns the diagnosis. What still holds from revision 2: the token is per work; other works' namings cannot stale it; naming a DIFFERENT path under the same claim is the recovery for a stuck journal. RULE until the fix lands: expect the first (and possibly every) evaluation after a naming to be refused; do not idle for it and do not loop (Greg, 2026-10-22: no ceremonial repeats); record the exact refusal and the evaluator's unrecorded verdicts on the item (the verdicts are in the delegation's full output) and report to the coordinator. Fix: w-33f4cde5413c GREEN-4, option A ruled 2026-10-22 23:14Z (the token binds to the named binding B; a +1 revision step whose frontier is Bound(B) under the same claim, workspace, generation, named_at and run identity is admitted). This entry retires when w-33f4 lands and is running on the host.
